name: Op NOVA (veterans in the justice system)
whoFor: Anyone in England who served at least a day and is in contact with the justice system.
eligibility: Served at least one day in the armed forces
In contact with the police, courts, prison or probation
gate: Has served in the UK armed forces (at least one day)
Is in contact with the police, courts, prison or probation
referralRoutes: Referral by an agency via the online form

selfReferral.note: Self-refer or be referred using the online form

activities.name: Support for justice-involved veterans
activities.summary: Help for veterans in contact with police, courts, prison or probation with housing, work, debt and health.
